notes.title: Early Access now available!
notes.notes:
Finally something playable for people to experience! As developer hope you guys report any bugs, issues or game breaking conundrums you guys experience.  As we go along and iron out all the bugs both story gameplay will keep updating behind the scenes until game is out of early release and it fully out. 
Bear with me and help me make this game something everyone can enjoy. Cheers ! Have fun!
